Class TurnOrderTile

java.lang.Object
mesos.order.TurnOrderTile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TurnOrderTile extends Object implements Serializable
The turn-order tile: an ordered sequence of TurnOrderSpaces on which players place their totems during the action phase to claim their place in next round's turn order. The last space is a penalty space.

  • Method Details

    • configureForPlayerCount

      public void configureForPlayerCount(PlayerCount playerCount)
      Configures the spaces and their food bonuses for the given player count. Food bonuses per space (last element = penalty space, bonus 0). Values from rulebook: 2p → +1,penalty; 3p → +2,0,penalty; 4p → +2,+1,0,penalty; 5p → +3,+1,0,0,penalty.

    • addTotem

      public TurnOrderSpace addTotem(Totem totem, Player player)
      Places the given totem on the first free space and records the owning player.
      Returns:
      the space the totem was placed on, or null if all spaces are full

    • determineNewOrder

      public List<Player> determineNewOrder()
      Returns the players in turn order for the next round, in the order their totems were placed on the spaces.

    • applySpaceEffect

      public void applySpaceEffect(TurnOrderSpace space, Player player)
      Applies the food bonus or penalty associated with a turn-order space. The last space deducts 1 food (or 2 PP if the player cannot pay).

    • getFirstFreeSpace

      public TurnOrderSpace getFirstFreeSpace()
      Returns the first space that currently has no totem, or null if all are occupied.

    • getSpaces

      public List<TurnOrderSpace> getSpaces()
      Returns a defensive copy of all spaces on this tile.

    • clearSpaces

      public void clearSpaces()
      Removes all totems from all spaces and clears the player mapping.

    • clearTotem

      public boolean clearTotem(Totem totem)
      Removes a single totem from whichever space it currently occupies. Used during the placement phase as players move their totems off the Turn Order Tile and onto Offer Tiles (rules §6).
      Parameters:
      totem - the totem to remove
      Returns:
      true if the totem was found and removed
